description: Smart cities in Poland indexes is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Dorota Sikora-Fernandez. Indicators for measuring the potential of urban smartness based on a set of variables in Poland. Data collected mainly from Central Statistical Office of Poland, www.stat.gov.pl. Coverage: national (PL); the metadata date the deposit to 2018. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
